new_skill_update_rules: New skill enters source registry or local skill inventory as intake only.
Capability classifier maps it to one or more route capabilities; ambiguous mappings require bounded probe, not runtime mount.
For each capability, compare Flash+Nexus without the skill against Flash+Nexus with the skill in the same session contract when live testing is required.
Only rows with selected/injected/used/evidence/gate/outcome receipts can increase effective_rows.
Catalog may update keep/alternate/replace/reject; runtime default apply requires separate apply gate.
Any trust mismatch, tokenless model call, selected-only effective row, wrong/quarantined mount, or missing receipt fails closed.

pipeline.gate: source ingest must map to capability and stay non-runtime

pipeline.output: capability-only + positive arm + negative control matrix

pipeline.gate: selected-only cannot count effective; missing receipt/evidence returns
catalog update only; runtime default unchanged
replacement record must cite evidence and receipt paths
